messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD INC-48291: rate_limiter_error spike detected on control-plane (alert: rate.limit.errored.count > 1000m)
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: INC-48291 auto-assigned to oncall-sre
seema patel: Acked. picking this up — oncall-sre
luis garcia: seeing customer 3xx/4xx spike in metrics dashboard, lots of 429s to a subset of tenants. linking logs now.
maya chen: +1 I can see a surge from a background job cluster hitting the embeddings route, but the rate limiter itself reports healthy tokens/sec on instances? odd.
seema patel: initial hypothesis: cache-stall caused duplicate enforcement and some tenant-specific quotas got applied twice. need to confirm whether quota-mapper double-applied mapping.
product-support: multiple customers reporting intermittent 429s and slow streaming. customer-impact: ~8 customers, highest 5% p95 latency increased from 340ms -> 1.8s
luis garcia: running quick query against quota events: ```select timestamp, tenant_id, action, rule_id from quota_events where timestamp > now() - 5m and action = 'apply' order by timestamp desc limit 50;``` results show duplicate apply events for same rule_id within <1s windows for tenants t-219, t-501
seema patel: good catch. that matches a cache invalidation race we pushed in the quota-mapper last week. but why paging now? maybe PD webhook triggered twice due to duplicate healthcheck alert.
maya chen: checking tracer -> I see short window where cache nodes returned stale TTL 0 and mapper retried; stack shows error path in `quota-mapper/main.go:applyRule` where we don't dedupe concurrent applies.
seema patel: mitigation plan: 1) add temporary circuit-breaker on quota-mapper to avoid duplicate applies 2) route affected tenants to fallback rate policy (lenient) 3) rollback the recent cache TTL change if needed
luis garcia: can we push a quick config flip to enable dedupe at the proxy level? a toggle exists: `quota_mapper.dedupe_concurrent=true` — if we flip it, it should stop duplicate apply attempts.
maya chen: i'd prefer routing fallback first to stop customer impact quickly. can someone open a routing override? seema?
seema patel: on it — creating routing override for tenants t-219,t-501,t-733. CLI snippet: ```rctl override add --tenants t-219,t-501,t-733 --policy fallback-lenient --reason "incident: duplicate quota applies" --expires 15m``` applying now
luis garcia: override applied. telemetry shows 429s for t-219 dropping by ~85% within 60s :thumbsup:
product-support: I've DM'd impacted customers with a brief note, will update status page. no major data loss, only rate-limited requests.
pagerduty: INC-48291 acknowledged by seema patel. Escalation path not triggered.
seema patel: next step: flip `quota_mapper.dedupe_concurrent=true` as a safe-mode toggle, then monitor for new duplicate events. planning a short window to toggle then roll back to normal once stable.
maya chen: toggle flip command: ```etcdctl put /config/quota_mapper/dedupe_concurrent true --ttl 300``` would make it temporary for 5m.
luis garcia: did the toggle; confirmed config propagated to all quota-mapper pods and metric for duplicate_apply_errors fell to 0 after ~30s.
seema patel: monitoring for 10m. if stable we'll keep fallback routing up for another 10 and then remove.
product-support: customers acknowledging reduced errors. updating status page: "Reduced error rates after mitigation, investigating root cause."
oncall-sre: handoff note — Maya will be primary for the next 2h while I take lunch. I'll leave the routing override in place and handoff context in pagerduty.
maya chen: taking over. I will keep watches and will escalate to eng-runtime if duplicate_apply_errors or 5xx spike returns. please leave any notes here.
seema patel: quick postmortem notes: probable root cause = cache TTL change + non-deduped concurrent apply path in quota-mapper. action items: revert TTL change, add server-side dedupe, add metric alert for duplicate_apply_events > 1/min, update runbook for routing override procedure.
luis garcia: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quota-mapper/issues/724 with repro and logs. assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime for next-day fix.
product-support: will send follow-up email to impacted customers once we have RCA.
maya chen: closing loop: removing routing override in 20m if metrics stable. leaving the incident open until then. :eyes:
seema patel: thanks team. incident-bot: set incident INC-48291 status -> monitoring
incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty will auto-resolve if no new pages in 60m
maya chen: resolved for tenants t-219,t-501,t-733; final check shows p95 back to baseline. marking this thread for postmortem write-up.
product-support: adding customer notes and timeline to the PM ticket.
seema patel: handoff complete. I am pausing; reach me if it regresses.
